text.p: Demand for shares in German phone giant Deutsche Telekom is so strong that the company believes the issue is already oversubscribed four times, the daily Handelsblatt newspaper said on Wednesday.
Citing unnamed sources at the company, the paper said Telekom expects its initial public offering could be oversubscribed five times by the time the subscription period ends on November 14.
Shares begin trading in Germany and New York on November 18 and a day later in Tokyo.
Telekom will float up to 500 million shares with another 75 million shares in an optional overallotment, or greenshoe. Shares are expected to cost around 30 marks ($19.67).
The newspaper said that oversubscription of the offer put demand at around 75 billion marks.
-- William Boston, Bonn Newsroom, 49 228 26097150 ($ = 1.525 German Marks)
